notes: Cycle 33033658714: Integrated accepted research findings from fractal-map and evaluation lanes. Added zoom coherence integration (39.6% improvement rate, 0 deteriorations), language dominance analysis for clusters, cross-language neighbor discovery, and TF-IDF text similarity for proximity explanations. All 13/13 tests pass (9 original + 4 new). Addresses evaluation finding that baseline is FALSIFIED (language dominance 0.982) and fractal-map finding that zoom reveals legally coherent substructure.
known_limitations: Section modes cover 63 of 1000 decisions (6.3%) — section projections only available for a subset
Frontend uses HTML5 Canvas only - no WebGL/Mapbox for large-scale rendering
No authentication or rate limiting on API
HDBSCAN produces fewer clusters than Leiden at same zoom levels (2-8 vs 5-21)
TF-IDF model uses truncated text (2000 chars max per document)
Cross-language neighbors limited by language-dominant clustering
Language filter is a simple toggle (no compound language queries)
Cluster coherence is computed on-demand (not cached server-side)
Frontend not yet updated to display zoom coherence and language analysis features
resolved_issues: Orchestration failure: Missing numpy dependency prevented test execution (fixed: requirements.txt added)
Corpus-map mismatch: Only 50 of 1000 map positions had corpus text (fixed: shows all 1000, has_corpus flag)
Wrong cluster assignments: Spatial grid clustering produced 136 clusters at zoom 0 (fixed: Leiden gives 5)
Server path bug: Path(__file__).parent.parent resolved to workspace root, server could not start (fixed: Path(__file__).parent)
n_clusters metadata: Reported inflated cluster counts (8,14,22,25) instead of actual Leiden counts (5,11,16,21) (fixed: use len(clusters))
Static file serving: _serve_file used parent.parent causing 404 for all static assets (fixed: use parent)
No user import capability: Users could not add their own corpora (fixed: POST /api/import with JSONL support)
Corpus scaling gap: Product had 250 decisions but map had 1000 positions (fixed: integrated full 1000-decision slice)
Corpus import test failure: Search limit too low for 1200+ decisions (fixed: use unique docket number for reliable match)
No map modes: Single TF-IDF view with no way to switch perspectives (fixed: 6 section-based modes + citation graph)
No proximity explanations: Users could not understand why decisions are neighbors (fixed: 6-feature decomposition engine)
No cluster coherence indicators: Users could not see what makes clusters coherent (fixed: language/branch/legal_area distributions)
No language awareness: Map showed all languages equally with no way to filter (fixed: language toggle + colored points)
No zoom coherence metrics: Users could not see how zoom reveals legal structure (fixed: zoom coherence API endpoints)
No language dominance analysis: Users could not see language dominance in clusters (fixed: cluster language analysis endpoint)
No cross-language discovery: Users could not find similar decisions in other languages (fixed: cross-language neighbors endpoint)
No text similarity: Proximity explanations lacked deep text similarity (fixed: TF-IDF cosine similarity)
